build_aiter_backend: build an AITerBackend instance that provides AITemplate-based attention implementation for sglang
create_aiter_impl: create an AITerImpl attention implementation with num_heads, head_size, softmax_scale, and causal flag
get_aiter_backend_enum: get the AttentionBackendEnum.AITER enum value from AITerBackend.get_enum()
get_aiter_impl_cls: get the AITerImpl class type from AITerBackend.get_impl_cls()
run_aiter_forward: run the AITerImpl forward pass with query, key, value tensors and return attention output
